Write a short text about a coastal storm. Output only the text.
Constraints (all binding):
C1: Exactly 4 sentences.
C2: Every sentence has between 6 and 12 words.
C3: Sentence i begins with the i-th letter of "WIND" (so the first letters are: W, I, N, D).
C4: Every sentence ends with a period; no other sentence-ending punctuation.
C5: The entire text must be in lowercase; no capital letters anywhere, not even at sentence starts.
C6: The words "this" and "light" must each appear at least once.
C7: No digits anywhere in the text.
C8: No commas anywhere in the text.
